requirements.title: 1. Complete the Baccalaureate Degree Requirements
requirements.source_text: Students must satisfy the specific degree requirements for their undergraduate major and fulfill the following University degree requirements: Exceptions for University Graduation Requirements including exemptions and waivers, are approved for specific majors and on a case-by-case evaluation only. Academic (program total units with an average 2.0 GPA - “C” or better) General Education (GE) (34 Lower Division + 9 Upper Division) American Institutions (AI) (0-6 units) (may be satisfied in GE Areas 3B, 4, UD 3, UD 4) Graduation Writing Assessment Requirement (GWAR) (3 units) Physical Education (PE) (0-2 units) Units in Residence (30 units, including 24 upper division and 12 in major) Upper Division Units (40 units, including 12 upper div in major for BA, 18 upper div in major for BS) Undergraduate Admission Procedures and Policies Apply for Graduation Information about the Commencement Ceremony and Conferral of the Degree

requirements.title: 2. Major Preparation (22 units)
requirements.source_text: CS 100W - Technical Writing Workshop 3 unit(s) (WID) or LLD 100W - Writing Workshop 3 unit(s) (WID)

children.title: Major Electives (15 units)
children.source_text: Complete 15 units from: (At least 3 units from an upper-division CS course and 3 units from an upper-division LING course) CS 22A - Python for Everyone 3 unit(s) (prior department consent required) CS 190 - Internship Project 1 unit(s) or CS 190I - Internship Project 3 unit(s) (at most 3 units may be used) LING 168 - Language, Society & AI 3 unit(s) May include up to three units from the following list of courses: CS 180 - Individual Studies 1-3 unit(s) (may be used with prior approval) or CS 180H Individual Studies for Honors 3 unit(s) (may be used with prior approval)
